name: vcad-kernel-wasm
description: WASM bindings for the vcad B-rep kernel

scripts.build: if [ -n "$VCAD_WASM_SKIP" ]; then echo "wasm build skipped (VCAD_WASM_SKIP set, assuming pkg/ is already populated)"; else wasm-pack build ../../crates/vcad-kernel-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/kernel-wasm/pkg && cp pkg/vcad_kernel_wasm* .; fi
